newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran's NIOC offers bunker fuel posted prices.
newsitem.headline: Iran's NIOC offers bunker fuel posted prices.

text.p: National Iranian Oil Company (NIOC) has started to supply bunker fuel from its terminals at Kharg Island and Bandar Mahshahr, the NIOC said on Thursday.

NIOC's Petroleum Products Marketing and Operations (PMO) division announced that its 280-cst straight-run fuel oil is $104 a tonne from Kharg Island and $99 a tonne from Bandar Mahshahr effective May 22.
PMO said in a faxed statement that it planned to issue "weekly or bi-weekly postings."
Iran bunker fuel would compete against supplies in the United Arab Emirates, Kuwait and Saudi Arabia, traders said.
